name: batch_corrected_probe
description: LR probe on frozen CONCH-TITAN after an OAUTHC-targeted feature-space batch correction, chosen by OAUTHC held-out AUROC. Sweeps ComBat (global) vs one-site OAUTHC->reference location/scale alignment (retro-OAU / pooled) against the raw baseline; keeps the winner. Corrections are unsupervised w.r.t. MSI and fit transductively on the scored cohort. Frozen features, no external data.

score_columns.name: p_msih
score_columns.description: OOF p(MSI-H), best OAUTHC-targeted batch correction
